name: obsidian
lore_descriptor: volcanic glass, flaked to an edge finer than any steel can take
first_pickup_chronicle: Obsidian. Volcanic glass, sharper than steel will ever be. I shaved my arm by accident testing it, and felt it flex like it wanted to shatter.
design_notes: Fills peak_floor 14 gap. High damage_mult (1.25) but brittle and magic-resistant (max_enchant 1). Weapon-only — no armor/shield use historically.
